items.title: A surjective flat morphism of finite presentation admits fppf local lifts of objects
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a surjective flat morphism of finite presentation of algebraic stacks admits, for every object over a scheme, an fppf covering of that scheme together with lifts of the object into the source (author lemma at source lines 5876-5884, label lemma-surjective-flat-locally-finite-presentation). The proof (source lines 5886-5910) base changes along the object, presents the resulting stack by a scheme and verifies that the composite is an fppf covering (proof lines 5886-5909). The choice of the presentation and the verification of the fppf conditions are the substance. H3.
